title: Canberra
keywords: capital of australia australian capital city act
extract: Canberra is the capital city of Australia. Founded following the federation of the colonies of Australia as the seat of government for the new nation, it is Australia's largest inland city and the eighth-largest Australian city overall.

title: Australia
extract: Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is a sovereign country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands. Its capital is Canberra, and its largest city is Sydney.

title: Percentage
extract: In mathematics, a percentage is a number or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100. To compute a percentage of a value, multiply the value by the percentage and divide by 100.

title: Sydney
keywords: sydney largest city australia new south wales
extract: Sydney is the capital city of the state of New South Wales and the most populous city in Australia. It is not the national capital; the capital of Australia is Canberra.
